question: Deficiency of which vitamin in the diet is most commonly linked to poor vision in dim light (night blindness)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vitamin A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vitamin A** is an essential nutrient for maintaining good vision, particularly in low-light conditions.
 
• A deficiency of **Vitamin A** often leads to a condition called **night blindness**, where individuals struggle to see in dim light.
